menu.title: 🎬 Video to Circle Bot Send a video — I'll turn it into a Telegram video note (circle). Choose a section:
info.text: 🎬 How to use 1. Send a video (file, video note or video document). 2. Wait for the conversion. 3. Get your circle. 📋 Formats: mp4, mov, avi, mkv, webm, flv, wmv, 3gp, ts, mts, vob and 30+ more. ⚙️ Telegram limits: the note is square, up to ~60 seconds, H.264/AAC codecs.
help.text: ℹ️ Help What the bot does: converts videos into Telegram video notes. Commands: /start — main menu /help — this help /setlanguage — change language /fragment — select a fragment /terms — terms /paysupport — payment support Plans: • Free — basic quality, daily limit • Pro — higher quality, bigger limits Open “💳 Subscription” for details. 🔒 Privacy: the bot works in private chats only.

support.terms: 📄 Terms of use The bot converts your videos into Telegram video notes. Only submit material you are entitled to process. Current limits and prices appear in Subscription; the cloud Bot API limits downloads to 20 MB. Pro is paid with Telegram Stars. Fixed-term purchases extend the current term; lifetime access is never shortened by renewal. Cancellation disables Pro immediately and forfeits remaining time; Stars are not refunded automatically. Payment issues and refund requests: /paysupport. Automatic renewal is not enabled. The bot stores your Telegram ID, name, preferences, usage statistics and payment records in SQLite. Source and output files are deleted after processing; Telegram file identifiers are retained for repeat delivery. Support messages are shared with administrators. Contact /paysupport about your data. /help and /paysupport are available; maintenance or failures may interrupt service.
